notice_sections:
## Existing OCR, raster and fixture notices

| Component / upstream organization | License and version | Local paths / preserved notice | Source or provenance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tesseract OCR and tessdata-fast — Tesseract project | Apache-2.0; preserve distribution-specific terms as recorded | [OCR notices](tools/local-ocr/notices/), including `tesseract-LICENSE`, `tessdata-fast-LICENSE`, `libtesseract5-copyright.txt`, `tesseract-ocr-eng-copyright.txt` | [Tesseract](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract); [local source pins](tools/local-ocr/provenance.json) |
| Leptonica — Dan Bloomberg and contributors | BSD-style terms exactly as bundled; distribution terms remain separate | `tools/local-ocr/notices/leptonica-source-leptonica-license.txt`, `liblept5-copyright.txt` | [Leptonica](https://github.com/DanBloomberg/leptonica); local OCR provenance |
| giflib — giflib contributors | MIT-style source license and distribution-specific notice | `tools/local-ocr/notices/giflib-source-COPYING`, `libgif7-copyright.txt` | [giflib](https://giflib.sourceforge.net/); local OCR provenance |
| Pillow and its bundled components | HPND and additional component-specific terms in the preserved notice | [PILLOW-LICENSE.txt](tools/static-raster/PILLOW-LICENSE.txt) | [Pillow](https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow); [raster documentation](docs/extraction/static-jpeg-webp.md) |
| DejaVu / Bitstream Vera font used for synthetic OCR raster | Bitstream Vera terms; DejaVu changes public domain; Debian packaging paragraphs retain their separately stated terms | [font-notice.txt](tests/extraction/local-ocr/fixtures/font-notice.txt) | [exact fixture provenance](tests/extraction/local-ocr/fixtures/provenance.json) |

All existing legal texts remain unchanged. Distribution notices may describe
packaging or optional components as well as the source itself; do not treat one
paragraph as a blanket project license. Preserve the applicable full texts when
distributing the corresponding component. The project MIT notice does not replace
them or relicense an external font, library, training-data file or service.
